core_delta: FRANK should stop representing a component as simply in-process/out-of-process or one-store/many-store. For every hot data path, model transaction domain, data placement, index placement, compute placement, process placement and fault domain independently while preserving one Clay semantic contract.
recommended_runtime_changes: Add PlacementVector to MOSAIC/UnifiedDB execution receipts.
Keep semantic organ identity independent of where bytes/indexes/compute physically live.
Allow same-process fusion of high-affinity query computation without forcing one physical storage engine.
Keep non-primary graph/vector/FTS/activation views rebuildable and source-epoch bound unless explicitly promoted by schema/evidence.
Persist query/selection receipts for consequential cognitive paths so candidate formation can be separated from GWT selection and model uptake.
Use result admissibility to prevent approximate/salience/model-internal values from being treated as exact canonical state.
Treat UNKNOWN dependency closure as a runtime escalation state.
Keep protected external resources outside cognitive data stores and check current release conditions at the final effect boundary.
Benchmark same-process packed data exchange separately from cross-process IPC; Arrow C Data Interface is not a generic IPC protocol.
evidence_from_u2: Mixed E2B SQLite read path p50: same-process separate stores 99.514 us; monolith 101.687 us; service-like JSON boundaries 120.382 us.
Write p50: monolith 6.866 us; canonical+outbox+derived 18.199 us; unsynchronized two-store 8.797 us in the mechanism-local in-memory benchmark.
Recovery: 533/1200 unsynchronized trials tore; canonical+outbox had 0 mismatches after replay; monolith had 0 mismatches.
Boundary identity: JSON host representation changed in 10000/10000 cases while typed ordered semantics were preserved in 10000/10000.
Selection integrity calibration: naive selection changed 516/700 constructed cases; authenticated-structure reselection restored the baseline in 700/700.
do_not_infer: Do not infer that monolith or polystore is globally faster from U2.
Do not treat E2B microseconds as FRANK/Linux/Android production latency.
Do not physically consolidate protected-resource handling, model runtime state or transient salience merely because semantics are unified.
Do not count cross-branch agreement as independent replication.
highest_next: Instrument one real FRANK episode trace end-to-end, replay it through competing PlacementVectors, then inject crash/restart and candidate-selection mutations before changing architecture placement.
